dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with .INC copybooks and MCPAREA/MCPDATA patterns typical of ORCA
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECEUPD ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL / no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) processing for Hiroshima/広域連合 regional federation; generates claim submission documents (診療報酬請求書)
purpose.summary: SOKATU3415 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates and prints insurance claim summary reports for the Hiroshima wide-area federation (広域連合). It reads receipt update files, accumulates counts and amounts by insurance category (公費, 後期高齢者, 福祉, etc.), and writes formatted output records for claim submission.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram from shell)
OCCURS tables for insurance category aggregation (SUM-KOH-TBL OCCURS 100)
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Version history spanning 2008-2016 with named authors
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text (appears garbled in latin-1 view). This is standard for JMA ORCA source files. The program is part of a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 2408 lines / ~99KB.
